groceries: Supermarkets, mini-markets, butcher, bakery, fruit and vegetables bought to cook or eat at home.
dining: Restaurants, cafes, bars, food delivery and coffee or snacks consumed outside the home.
transport: Taxi, service, bus, fuel, car repair, parking, airport rides and travel tickets.
utilities: Electricity, generator subscription, water, internet, mobile plans and cooking gas.
housing: Rent, building charges, concierge and repairs to the home itself.
health: Pharmacy, doctor, dentist, laboratory tests, hospital and health insurance.
education: School and university fees, textbooks, courses, tutoring and school stationery.
shopping: Clothes, shoes, electronics, household goods, gifts and other retail purchases.
entertainment: Cinema, streaming subscriptions, games, concerts, sports and hobbies.
other: Anything that fits nothing above: bank fees, charity, taxes, grooming and money given to family.
